name: ties-and-withholding
title: When true values can be equal
idea: When true values can be exactly equal, a shared grade still claims no equality, and postrank's equality-neutral risk prices stated and withheld pairs differently from the weak loss.
from: new concept · v1 storyboard P-10; postrank vignette m4 (the m4 tie law, equality-neutral risk); picture: the three action risks for a pair whose true values can be equal, under the weak loss and the equality-neutral risk, with the all-withheld baseline R₀ beside τ and the switch points (vignette m4's law)
caption: Complete synthetic law after postrank vignette m4; weak-error and equality-neutral loss are different decision conventions.
